national_news.title: Sports, Education Ministries and UNESCO Partner for Clean Sport Values
bullets: The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Ministry of Education, and UNESCO signed an MoU for the ‘Sports Values in Every Classroom Toolkit’.
The initiative aims to embed values like respect, integrity, and fairness among children through education and sports.
Toolkit video modules will be made available in 13 Indian languages to reach nationwide students.

national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves Major Manufacturing Schemes and Rural Development Initiative
bullets: Approved the Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme with an outlay of Rs 10,000 crore up to FY 2039-40 to reduce import dependence.
Approved the Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme with an outlay of Rs 1,856 crore (2026-27 to 2033-34) to establish dedicated Sports Goods Manufacturing Zones.
Approved the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana (PMVGSY) with an outlay of Rs 7,395 crore to empower over 2.78 lakh Rural Local Bodies.

national_news.title: EAM S Jaishankar to Attend G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting and CHOGM
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar will attend the G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Atlanta, USA, followed by a QUAD Foreign Ministers Meeting.
He will lead the Indian delegation to the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM) in St John’s, Antigua and Barbuda.
India will host the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum meeting in New Delhi from 20th to 22nd November.

national_news.title: PM Modi Speaks at Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave in New Delhi, emphasizing scientific research and indigenous innovation.
Highlighted the achievement of first criticality by the 500-Megawatt Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor.
Noted that annual patent filings have surged from under 50,000 a decade ago to nearly 1.5 lakh last year.

national_news.title: India to Amend National Anti-Doping Act to Introduce Criminal Provisions
bullets: Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Mansukh Mandaviya announced plans to introduce criminal provisions through amendments to the National Anti-Doping Act.
The proposed move aims to strengthen action against doping violations, specifically targeting coaches and supply chain stakeholders.
The National Anti-Doping Agency (NADA) conducted over 7,000 tests and organized more than 350 education sessions during 2025-26.

national_news.title: Cyclonic Storm Arnab Lashes Southern Odisha
bullets: Severe cyclonic storm Arnab crossed the Andhra Pradesh and Odisha coast with sustained wind speeds of 125 to 135 kmph and gusts up to 145 kmph.
The India Meteorological Department (IMD) issued red and orange warnings for several districts in southern Odisha, including Ganjam, Gajapati, Koraput, Malkangiri, and Nabarangpur.
State authorities shifted over one lakh people from vulnerable areas to safer locations and suspended train and bus services in affected regions.

national_news.title: Goa Entrepreneur Success Story Highlighted under National SARAS Mela 2026
bullets: Siddhi, an entrepreneur from North Goa associated with the Mahamaya Self-Help Group (SHG), expanded her Instagram-based ethnic wear business to an annual turnover of Rs 60 lakh.
Her entrepreneurial journey was featured by the Press Information Bureau (PIB) as part of the government's National SARAS Mela 2026.
Self-help groups and government initiatives continue to empower women entrepreneurs by facilitating networking, skill development workshops, and financial guidance.

national_news.title: Mobile PLI Scheme Generates Rs 25,000 Crore in Direct Taxes
bullets: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated that the mobile phone Production-Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme generated Rs 25,000 crore in direct taxes against an incentive payout of Rs 19,000 crore.
The mobile manufacturing sector alone employs 12 lakh people, contributing significantly to domestic production and exports.
The Union Cabinet approved the subsequent Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme (MPMS) with an outlay of Rs 62,500 crore to run from FY 2026-27 to FY 2030-31.

national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves 3% Hike in Dearness Allowance for Central Employees
bullets: The Union Cabinet approved an additional installment of Dearness Allowance (DA) and Dearness Relief (DR) with effect from July 1, 2026, marking a 3% increase over the existing 60% rate.
The revision will benefit approximately 48.54 lakh Central Government employees and 68.71 lakh pensioners.
The combined financial impact on the exchequer is estimated at Rs 10,016.10 crore per annum, based on 7th Central Pay Commission recommendations.

national_news.title: India and HD Hyundai Advance Rs 38,000 Crore Thoothukudi Mega Shipyard Project
bullets: Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal met HD Hyundai Chairman Chung Ki-sun in Seoul to advance the proposed greenfield shipyard at Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu.
The project is valued at approximately Rs 38,000 crore ($4 billion) with an annual capacity of 2.5 million Gross Tonnage, aiming to be India's largest commercial shipyard.
The initiative aligns with India's Maritime Amrit Kaal Vision 2047, targeting an annual shipbuilding output of 4.5 million GT by 2047.

national_news.title: India and Mexico Formally Launch Preferential Trade Agreement Negotiations
bullets: India and Mexico signed Terms of Reference (ToR) to launch negotiations for a Preferential Trade Agreement (PTA) to expand bilateral trade and supply chains.
The ToR was signed by Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal and Mexico's Undersecretary of Foreign Trade Luis Rosendo Gutiérrez Romano.
Bilateral trade between India and Mexico stood at USD 7.83 billion in the 2025-26 fiscal year.

national_news.title: UAE President Honours Indian Pilot Captain Smit Machchhar with Order of Zayed II
bullets: UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan conferred the First Class Order of Zayed II, a top civilian award, on flydubai Captain Smit Machchhar and his crew.
The award recognizes their bravery and professionalism during an in-flight attack aboard flight FZ1073, safely diverting the plane to Tabuk, Saudi Arabia.
The honor was presented by UAE Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Defence Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum.

bihar_news.title: Delhi Government Proposes AC Luxury Bus Services to Bihar for Chhath Puja
bullets: The Delhi Transport Department proposed direct AC luxury bus services to Bihar, connecting over 50 buses to seven destinations including Patna, Gaya, and Muzaffarpur.
The initiative aims to ease travel for devotees during Chhath Puja 2026, pending final approval from Lieutenant Governor TS Sandhu.
The 12-metre BS-VI compliant Volvo buses will operate under a wet-lease arrangement managed by private operators on behalf of the Delhi Transport Corporation (DTC).

bihar_news.title: Bihar Cabinet Approves MSME Policy 2026 Targeting 1 Crore Entrepreneurial Families
bullets: The Bihar cabinet approved the MSME Policy 2026 under the motto 'Ek crore udyami parivar, sashakt Bihar ka aadhar', targeting one crore entrepreneurial families and direct/indirect jobs over five years.
The policy aims to raise Bihar's credit-deposit ratio from over 60% to 75% and establish an MSME centre in each of the state's 38 districts.
The cabinet also sanctioned Rs 1.99 crore for an MoU with the National Institute of Hydrology, Roorkee, to study floodplain zones along the Kosi, Gandak, and Sone rivers.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Announces Plans for Signature Roads Across All Cities to Support Urban Growth
bullets: Urban Development and Housing Minister Nitish Mishra announced plans to develop signature roads across all Bihar cities to manage accelerating urbanisation.
Currently, around 11% of Bihar's population lives in urban areas compared to the national average of 33%, necessitating planned infrastructure growth and satellite townships.
The announcement was made during the valedictory session of a junior engineers' training programme at the Lalit Narayan Mishra Institute of Economic Development and Social Change.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Demands Water Security Revision Ahead of Indo-Bangladesh Ganga Treaty Renewal
bullets: The 1996 Ganga Water Sharing Treaty between India and Bangladesh expires in 2026, prompting Bihar to seek structural revisions to protect its agricultural and drinking water needs.

Under the 1996 treaty, water at Farakka Barrage during the lean period (January–June) is shared based on specific flow thresholds, guaranteeing Bangladesh up to 35,000 cusecs during peak lean periods.

Bihar representatives highlighted that despite the state possessing 16% of the Ganga's catchment area and feeding the river through 12 tributaries, it bears disproportionate burden to meet downstream treaty commitments.

bihar_news.title: ICAR-MGIFRI Motihari Launches Soil Health Program Under Khet Bachao Abhiyan
bullets: ICAR–Mahatma Gandhi Integrated Farming Research Institute (MGIFRI), Motihari, organized a soil health awareness program under 'Khet Bachao Abhiyan – Rabi 2026' in East Champaran, Bihar.
The initiative focuses on restoring soil health, balanced nutrient management, and developing climate-resilient farming techniques for flood-prone 'Chaur' (waterlogged) ecosystems.
Fields were categorized by water stagnation severity (3–5 days vs 13–15 days) to provide customized technical guidance for location-specific Rabi crop planning.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Delegation Studies Maharashtra's Panchayati Raj System in Nashik
bullets: A high-level delegation from Bihar's Panchayati Raj Department, led by Director Naveen Kumar Singh (IAS), visited the Nashik Zilla Parishad in Maharashtra.
The primary objective of the exposure visit was to conduct a comparative study on administrative structures, internal revenue generation, and financial empowerment of local self-government bodies.
Discussions centered on fund allocation processes, administrative-political coordination, and effective execution of development projects across Gram Panchayats and Zilla Parishads.

bihar_news.title: Gyan Bhadra's Book 'The Advent of a Statesman' on Bihar's Governance Released in Delhi
bullets: A new book titled 'The Advent of a Statesman: Bihar Has Never Had It So Good', authored by journalist Gyan Bhadra, was launched at the Press Club of India in New Delhi.
The publication was formally unveiled by Press Club of India President Sangeeta Barooah Pisharoty during a literature festival.
The book critically examines Bihar's development trajectory, governance challenges, agricultural distress, institutional capacity, and political leadership.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Museum Ranks 9th Globally and 1st in Asia in World's 100 Best Museums List
bullets: Bihar Museum in Patna secured the 9th position in the 'World’s 100 Best Museums 2026' ranking released by global travel platform Worth a Journey.
The museum ranked 1st in Asia, making it the highest-ranked Asian institution and the only Indian museum featured in the top 100 global list.
Mexico City’s Museo Nacional de Antropología topped the global list, followed by Spain’s Museo del Prado (2nd) and Denmark’s Louisiana Museum of Modern Art (3rd).

bihar_news.title: Bihar Introduces Performance Assessment Index for Banks; Muzaffarpur Startup Innovates Corn Husk Utensils
bullets: The Bihar government introduced a 100-point performance assessment index to rank state banks; IDFC FIRST Bank topped the evaluation with 74 points.
As of September 30, 2026, Bihar achieved 38.25% (₹1.89 lakh crore) of its ₹4.95 lakh crore Annual Credit Plan target for 2026–27, with the state Credit-Deposit Ratio (CDR) standing at 60.17%.

Naz Ozair, an engineer from Muradpur in Muzaffarpur district, established MNO Swadeshi India Pvt. Ltd. and patented technology to convert discarded corn husks into single-use plastic utensil alternatives.
